name: Uruzuki
source:
The 13th Moon Maiden who serves the Moon Goddess. Within the castle where all men and women sleep, it is only she who is awake and watches over the princess.

[From [url=https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000004727.000001719.html]PR Times[/url]]
